historicalSeedDialogue.text: I've bought a replacement mug. Not that anyone needs to say anything.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: B
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Did I break your mug?

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Interesting that you started there.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: B
historicalSeedDialogue.text: I'm sorry about the mug.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Keep that tone. Think a little more recently.

historicalSeedDialogue.text: Are we opening a window?

historicalSeedDialogue.text: Some things require more than ventilation.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: B
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Have I upset you?

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: You do such beautiful handwriting. Even your bin labels are elegant.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: B
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Thank you.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Imagine what you could do with these eighty place cards.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: B
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Are you asking me to write them?

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: I wouldn't presume. I'm leaving room for your artistic impulse.
